source_evidence.summary: When GGML_CUDA_MOE_STREAM_BATCH is not defined, ggml_cuda_moe_stream_batch and ggml_cuda_moe_stream_up_gate_batch are stub functions returning false without decline logs.
GGML_CUDA_MOE_STREAM_BATCH is a CMake option defaulting OFF and only defines the full batch translation unit when ON.
Down batch is only attempted when GGML_MOE_STREAM_DOWN_BATCH is set and then calls ggml_cuda_moe_stream_batch; in the accepted build this resolves to the stub.
Up/gate batch calls ggml_cuda_moe_stream_up_gate_batch when CUDA stream helpers are available; in the accepted build this also resolves to the stub.
